tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html; agent-browser --session $S eval 'document.querySelector(".form-horizontal strong")?.innerText'

S=task-4f8cb3580297; for p in index page-2; do agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/$p.html >/dev/null 2>&1; agent-browser --session $S eval '[...document.querySelectorAll("article.product_pod")].filter(a=>a.querySelector(".star-rating.Five")).map(a=>a.querySelector("h3 a").title+" | "+a.querySelector(".price_color").innerText).join("\n")'; done
